clause_rationales.diagnostic_rationale: R1 aggregate diagnostics found that the outcome-free extreme source-ready contention tail (at least 100 alternatives excluding baseline) contained 10 of 37 I1 precondition false positives but only 3 of 27 completed I1 attempts. Excluding this stress tail uses no descriptor identifier or outcome field, preserves 1,256 non-R1 I1 candidates, and leaves every I3/I4 candidate eligible.
